description: This Zenodo deposit contains annotated 640-by-640 images of FM spectrum measurements for signal detection. The describing article says the images derive from waterfall views of field strength across the 87.5–108 MHz broadcast band and identifies anomalies such as a transmission stopping, modulation stopping, a transmission starting or signal-strength changes. The Hungarian monitoring network has nationwide coverage, but the landing page does not establish which stations or observation dates contribute to this image subset. Zenodo lists a public annotated_images.zip archive under CC BY 4.0. A modeller could train a detection component and use its false alarms or missed anomalies in a broadcast-service monitoring simulation. The pictures do not themselves state which events caused real receiver outages. Some signal variation can follow weather, not equipment failure. The archive and labels were not downloaded or checked. This is a derived annotated-image deposit, distinct from the raw FM measurements at G4-0539; no directly related catalogue record was identified.
